title: Peck Kelly's extended harmonies and Manno subbing on bass
summary: Manno says nobody plays like Kelly, who blew up chords and dropped the fundamentals; Manno was his first substitute bassist.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
